contests.title: Finney County — Building and road maintenance sales tax renewal

provenance.sourceOrg: Finney County Clerk and Election Officer
provenance.quote: Shall Finney County, Kansas, be authorized to impose a one-quarter percent (0.25%) countywide retailers’ sales tax (the “Sales Tax”) upon the expiration of the existing one- quarter percent (0.25%) countywide retailers’ sales tax, and pledge the revenues from the Sales Tax to paying for and/or financing needed existing building and road maintenance to include the purchase of necessary equipment to complete the needs as determined necessary by the Board of County Commissioners; with the collection of the Sales Tax to commence on October 1, 2027, or as soon thereafter as permitted by law, and shall terminate ten years after its commencement; all pursuant to the provisions of K.S.A. 12-187 et seq., as amended? The apportionment formula provided in K.S.A. 12-192, and amendments thereto, will apply to the revenues received from the Sales Tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Renews the county’s 0.25% sales tax for ten years after the existing tax expires. Collection would start October 1, 2027, or as soon afterward as the law allows. The money would pay for or finance existing building and road maintenance, including necessary equipment, as determined by county commissioners. Revenue would be shared under the state’s county sales-tax formula.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the replacement 0.25% sales tax for the stated maintenance purposes and ten-year term.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not approve this renewal; the existing tax would end on its current schedule.
